operationName: Ebola PHEIC Response — 2026 Bundibugyo Outbreak, DRC & Uganda
heroHeadline: BDBV Outbreak: 900+ Suspected Cases — Uganda Jumps to 12; 18 ETU Patients Missing
heroSubtitle: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak accelerated sharply on 25 May as Uganda confirmed 12 cases — up from 5 in 48 hours — and all 18 suspected patients who fled the Mongbwalu ETU fire remain unaccounted. DRC has 900+ suspected cases across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, and Sud-Kivu. No licensed BDBV vaccine exists; Oxford's ChAdOx1 candidate is 6–9 months from human trials. The US pledged to fund up to 50 response clinics and ~$55M total in bilateral aid.
footerNote: Data sourced from WHO Situation Reports, DRC Ministry of Health (MSANTE), Uganda Ministry of Health, CDC Emergency Operations, MSF field reports, ECDC, US State Department, Oxford University Jenner Institute, and institutional analyses. Case counts and CFR figures are rapidly evolving.
